database_evidence: SQLite plus a fresh PostgreSQL 18.6 database named platform_tasks_20261103

history.failure: Hosted race shard 3 observed a replay 404 when an omitted runAt default crossed one database millisecond between request parsing and admission.
history.fix: ff9d2f4b leaves omitted runAt/expiresAt unset through parsing and lets the admission transaction choose one clock value. The focused test then passed 20 repeated race runs.

coverage: A durable task is admitted through a service assertion, claimed by a separate worker process without a browser session, transitioned to running, executed by the fixed handler registry and committed.
The administrator page shows state, due time, attempts, safe errors and result summaries without exposing task payloads or editing the immutable execution tuple.
limits: The scheduled-digest app and native app.backend.task exchange are not yet implemented; this evidence uses the fixed adapter test seam for the backend task family.

coverage: Claim, fence and revision are conditional; the attempt row is inserted in the same transaction.
Restore converts nonterminal tasks to review_required, closes in-flight attempts as uncertain and never schedules an automatic retry.
A lost external confirmation is represented as uncertain and does not release a result.
limits: A real worker process has not yet been killed on both sides of a native external effect; that remains part of native task acceptance.

coverage: Admission enforces global, per-app and per-installation active-task ceilings under an admission transaction.
PostgreSQL concurrent claims use SKIP LOCKED and exactly one worker wins; SQLite uses its single-writer transaction.
limits: No measured flood drill yet proves that one saturated app cannot affect analysis or authentication latency.

coverage: Disable, uninstall and publisher revocation cancel waiting tasks and move in-flight tasks to uncertain.
Capability revocation is rechecked before the claim, start and completion boundaries; disabled or stale generations cannot be claimed.
A stale worker cannot commit completion after authority changes.
limits: This covers the task surface only, not event subscription delivery.

coverage: Task restore leaves all nonterminal work review_required and closes in-flight attempts uncertain.
Uncertain tasks never re-enter the waiting queue; administrator review can only close them as failed or cancelled.
limits: The existing notification restore evidence remains separate and continues to govern notification delivery pause and replay.
